cover_headline: White House Touts $330 Billion in Indian Investment as 'Trillions Pour In'
facts: The White House's latest investment showcase lists $330.5 billion in India-linked commitments, PTI reported
A $300 billion Reliance partnership for a Texas refinery was announced in March, and Indian industry pledged up to $20.5 billion at the SelectUSA summit in May
A second White House tracker counts India at $500 billion, ranking sixth, behind the UAE, Qatar, Japan, Saudi Arabia and EU firms

end.headline: White House Touts $330 Billion in Indian Investment as 'Trillions Pour In'
end.line: Two India entries — a $300 billion Reliance refinery partnership and $20.5 billion in SelectUSA pledges — put India among America's largest announced investors, though a second White House tracker counts $500 billion.
